import json, os, glob
d='/home/rudra/Projects/OpenCode-Vault/control-plane/decision-queue/cards'
fixed=0
for p in sorted(glob.glob(d+'/*.json')):
    raw=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
    try: json.loads(raw); continue
    except json.JSONDecodeError: pass
    dec=json.JSONDecoder(); objs=[]; i=0; n=len(raw); bad=False
    while i<n:
        while i<n and raw[i].isspace(): i+=1
        if i>=n: break
        try: o,j=dec.raw_decode(raw,i); objs.append(o); i=j
        except json.JSONDecodeError: bad=True; break
    if objs and not bad:
        tmp=p+'.tmp'
        with open(tmp,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(objs[0],f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); f.write('\n')
        os.rename(tmp,p); fixed+=1
print("fixed:",fixed)
